title: Screensaver: symlink screensaver.txt to HYPRARCH logo.txt
description: Replace ~/.config/omarchy/branding/screensaver.txt with a symlink to ~/dotfiles/omarchy-customizations/logo.txt (back up the stock file first). Done when: AC4 passes (screensaver shows HYPRARCH and fits the screen).

title: install-logo.sh: check/repair screensaver symlink after updates
description: Extend install-logo.sh (run by post-update.d/10-restore-branding) to verify the screensaver.txt symlink and restore it if missing, replaced or wrong (no sudo). Done when: AC5 passes (overwrite with stock art, run the hook, HYPRARCH is restored).

title: Ghostty: SHIFT+Insert pastes clipboard, not PRIMARY
description: Add keybind = shift+insert=paste_from_clipboard to ghostty/.config/ghostty/config. Done when: AC2 and AC3 pass (SUPER+V and picker text entries paste the clipboard in Ghostty).

title: bindings.lua: image-aware SUPER+V in terminals
description: Override SUPER+V: in a terminal, send CTRL+V if wl-paste --list-types has image/*, else SHIFT+Insert; non-terminals send CTRL+V. Done when: AC1 passes, AC2 still passes, and hyprctl configerrors is empty.

title: Restore clipboard paste + HYPRARCH screensaver after Omarchy 4
description:
## What & why
Omarchy 4 (upgrade 2026-08-28) broke three things:
1. **Screenshot paste in Claude Code via SUPER+V.** The screenshot *is* on the clipboard (verified by sha256). Omarchy's universal paste sends SHIFT+Insert to terminals; Ghostty's default `shift+insert=paste_from_selection` pastes the PRIMARY selection (last highlighted text). Terminals also cannot paste images: Claude Code only reads images on CTRL+V.
2. **SUPER+CTRL+V clipboard picker "not working" in terminals.** The picker opens (bind is live, no config errors), but choosing an entry pastes via `wtype SHIFT+Insert`, so Ghostty again pastes the PRIMARY selection.
3. **Screensaver shows OMARCHY, not HYPRARCH.** `omarchy-upgrade-to-quattro` overwrote `~/.config/omarchy/branding/screensaver.txt` with stock art. The existing `post-update.d/10-restore-branding` hook covers /usr/share targets, not this one.

## Scope (v1)
- Ghostty: `keybind = shift+insert=paste_from_clipboard`
- bindings.lua: image-aware SUPER+V. In a terminal, if the clipboard offers image/*, send CTRL+V; otherwise SHIFT+Insert. Non-terminals are unchanged (CTRL+V).
- Screensaver: `~/.config/omarchy/branding/screensaver.txt` becomes a symlink to `~/dotfiles/omarchy-customizations/logo.txt` (single source of truth)
- install-logo.sh (run by the post-update hook): check and repair the screensaver symlink, with no sudo needed for that target

## Out of scope
- Lock-screen logo / 5s blank (decided 2026-08-31: leave as-is)
- Cloning the omarchy.clipboard plugin. Consequence: picking an *image* entry in SUPER+CTRL+V while in a terminal copies it but does not paste it; press SUPER+V or CTRL+V after.
- Terminals other than Ghostty

## Key decisions
- Ghostty rebind vs cloning the clipboard plugin: the rebind is one line and survives updates; a clone drifts from upstream.
- Lua `io.popen` (verified available) with `timeout 0.3 wl-paste --list-types` keeps the image check bounded.
- Tradeoff: SHIFT+Insert no longer pastes the PRIMARY selection in Ghostty (middle-click still does).
- Symlink vs copy: a symlink keeps the art in git. Caveat: `omarchy branding screensaver reset` would `cp` stock art through the symlink into logo.txt (recover with git checkout); the hook detects any mismatch.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1: After a screenshot, SUPER+V in Claude Code (Ghostty) attaches the image.
- AC2: With text on the clipboard, SUPER+V in Ghostty pastes clipboard text, not highlighted text.
- AC3: SUPER+CTRL+V opens the picker in Ghostty; choosing a text entry pastes that entry.
- AC4: The screensaver (`omarchy-launch-screensaver force`) shows HYPRARCH.
- AC5: If screensaver.txt is overwritten with stock art, running the post-update hook restores it.
- AC6: `hyprctl configerrors` is empty; all changes are committed in dotfiles.
